dct_description_sm: Abstract: This layer contains point features of all private and charter schools in Cambridge. Only one building per school has a point.
Purpose: Created for general use for City staff. Used for both mapping and specific identification of buildings with a similar use.

Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
